items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: Was that the Japan trip with George Lewis? ... George, we didn't have a choice of that. ... I thought that was one of the highest points in my life in playing musicians, to be around new celebrities.

ctx.x: Because he knew, he knew, the rules and the recreation of the band, which goes with all bands, all organizations. And we got to be close friends after they found out that we could draw as much as they draw, as much as they draw, and we did. And it even amazes me.
When were you traveling around? Was that the Japan trip with George Lewis? No, I can tell you, the man out of New York,

George, we didn't have a choice of that. Oh, so that was fairly recently. No, no, no, that's been about four or five years ago, I think. To me that's pretty, yeah. That was amazing, man. I thought that was one of the highest points in my life in playing musicians, to be around new celebrities. And I thought that was one of the highest points in my life musicians. I mean, those guys are way much for a musician.
